skill_name: Write a short story that takes place in the city of Paris, France.
workflow: Jason was walking the streets of Paris, taking in the sights, when he happened upon a café he had been looking for. He took a seat and ordered a hot cup of coffee. As he sipped, he looked around and noticed a woman at the corner of the cafe who seemed to be watching him from a distance. He smiled, and she smiled back. Soon, they were talking like old friends.
